o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *öp-. Cognate with Turkish öpmek.
From Ottoman Turkish آلای (alay), from Medieval Greek ἀλλάγιον (allágion).
Borrowed from Arabic مَثَلًا (maṯalan, “for example”), from the adverbial accusative of مَثَل (maṯal, “example”). By surface analysis, məsəl + -ən.
From Persian مرجومک (marjomak), vulgarized from Persian مردمک (mardomak, “pupil of the eye”).
From Persian بند. Doublet of banda.
